text_en: FlowPredictor–Corrector, our hemodynamics-guided vascular flow prediction study, was published online in IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics on 8 October.
text_cn: FlowPredictor–Corrector 血流动力学引导的血流预测研究于 10 月 8 日在线发表于 IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics。

text_en: Our report-based carotid plaque AHA classification study was accepted by Insights into Imaging. Publication is forthcoming.
text_cn: 基于 MRI 报告的大语言模型辅助颈动脉斑块 AHA 分型研究获 Insights into Imaging 接收，待正式发表。

text_en: Welcome to our 2026 cohort of medical and engineering graduate students. Their profiles and degree programs are now listed on the team page.
text_cn: 欢迎 2026 级医学与工学研究生加入团队！成员页已更新新同学的个人资料及学硕、专硕、直博等培养类型。

text_en: Our 16-year cohort study of age-related intracranial injury risk after craniomaxillofacial trauma was published online in BMC Medical Imaging.
text_cn: 颅颌面创伤后急性颅内损伤年龄相关风险的 16 年队列研究在线发表于 BMC Medical Imaging，重点关注孤立性面部骨折的老年患者。

text_en: Our study of pulmonary artery-to-vein volume difference for acute pulmonary embolism risk stratification was published online in Academic Radiology.
text_cn: 肺动静脉体积差用于急性肺栓塞风险分层的研究在线发表于 Academic Radiology。

text_en: AbdomenNet, our non-contrast CT foundation model for acute abdominal diagnosis, risk stratification, and triage, was published online in Nature Communications on 12 August.
text_cn: AbdomenNet 非增强 CT 急腹症诊断、风险分层与分诊基础模型于 8 月 12 日在线发表于 Nature Communications。

text_en: Our imaging-grounded multi-agent MLLM study of acute ischemic stroke treatment recommendations was published in npj Digital Medicine.
text_cn: 影像驱动的急性缺血性卒中多智能体 MLLM 治疗推荐研究发表于 npj Digital Medicine。

text_en: BoneCoT, our whole-body skeletal foundation model study for bone metastasis assessment, was published in Nature Biomedical Engineering on 2 July.
text_cn: BoneCoT 全身骨骼基础模型与骨转移评估研究于 7 月 2 日发表于 Nature Biomedical Engineering。

text_en: HR-LLM-Stroke, our multi-agent LLM study of emergency stroke treatment recommendations, was published in Journal of Medical Internet Research.
text_cn: HR-LLM-Stroke 急诊卒中多智能体大语言模型治疗推荐研究发表于 Journal of Medical Internet Research。

text_en: LumbarSR, our paired clinical CT and micro-CT dataset for lumbar vertebra super-resolution, was published in Scientific Data.
text_cn: LumbarSR 配对临床 CT 与显微 CT 的腰椎超分辨率数据集发表于 Scientific Data。

text_en: BrainMIND, our benchmark evaluating LLM diagnostic impressions from brain MRI report findings, was published in npj Digital Medicine.
text_cn: BrainMIND 基于脑 MRI 报告所见生成诊断结论的大语言模型评测研究发表于 npj Digital Medicine。
